labels.shortDescription: Appeal parent would create a loop
labels.value: That parent appeal would create a loop, because this appeal is already above it. Choose a different parent appeal, or leave Parent Appeal empty.

labels.shortDescription: Default fund could not be saved
labels.value: The default fund could not be saved. Nothing was changed. Open Nonprofit Settings, choose Giving, and set the default fund there, or ask your administrator to check the error log.

labels.shortDescription: Fund has gifts and cannot be deleted
labels.value: Gifts have been designated to this fund, so it cannot be deleted: deleting it would leave those gifts pointing at nothing. Untick Active instead, and the fund stops being offered on new gifts while it keeps its history.

labels.shortDescription: Two funds marked default in one save
labels.value: Only one fund can be the default. Save one default fund at a time, and Open Impact will clear the flag on the previous one.

labels.shortDescription: Allocation could not follow the amount
labels.value: The gift's allocation could not be updated to match the new amount, so nothing was changed. Ask your administrator to check the error log.

labels.shortDescription: Allocations do not total the gift
labels.value: The allocations of this gift total {0}, but the gift is {1}. The difference is {2}.

labels.shortDescription: Nothing left of the gift to reverse
labels.value: This gift is already {0}, so there is nothing left to refund or write off.

labels.shortDescription: Amount changed on a split gift
labels.value: This gift is split across more than one fund, so its amount cannot be changed here. Adjust the allocations first, then change the amount.

labels.shortDescription: Refund attempted on a negative gift
labels.value: This gift already records money going back, so it cannot itself be refunded or written off. Open the original gift instead.

labels.shortDescription: Default allocation could not be created
labels.value: The gift could not be allocated to the default fund, so it was not saved. Check that you have access to create allocations, or ask your administrator to check the error log.
No default fund is set. Open Nonprofit Settings, choose Giving, and pick the fund that undesignated gifts should go to.
That gift could not be found, so nothing was changed. It may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.
This gift has a receipt number, so its amount, date, donor and in-kind description cannot change. Void the receipt and reissue it, or record a refund.

The receipt lock was lifted on gift {0} (receipt number {1}) by a user holding the Override Receipt Lock permission. What changed: {2}. Check that this correction was expected, and remove the permission from whoever holds it.
This gift's receipt number cannot be changed or cleared, because a donor is holding the receipt that carries it. Void the receipt and reissue it instead.
This gift has a receipt number, so it cannot be deleted: a donor is holding the receipt. Record a refund or a write-off instead.

labels.shortDescription: Refund amount missing or not positive
labels.value: Enter how much is going back to the donor. A refund amount is always more than zero: Open Impact records it as a negative gift for you.

labels.shortDescription: Refund larger than what is left
labels.value: This refund is larger than the amount left on the gift. Check the gift's refunds: part of it may have gone back already.

labels.shortDescription: Gift with a refund cannot be deleted
labels.value: This gift has a refund or a write-off linked to it, so it cannot be deleted: deleting it would leave the negative gift explaining nothing. Delete the refund first if it was recorded in error.
